title: Part IV · Section 01
subtitle: To-inf / gerunds
introEn: Read each item carefully. For multiple-choice items, choose the best answer. For Warm-Up and Grammar Practice, follow the instruction in each prompt and type your answer (rewritten sentence, correction, or word/phrase as asked).

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (a): What we have to do first is to ______ where to go.
items.label: (a)
items.stem: What we have to do first is to ______ where to go.

items.label: (c)

items.label: (b)

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (d): Did he ______ that I'm a secret agent?
items.label: (d)
